scenes: Can a fix for heat make heat worse?
Yes. That’s maladaptation. | An air conditioner cools a room, | but it pumps that heat into the street, and studies link it to warmer nights outside.
So before any fix, ask: | who else does this affect? | What happens later? | And who is left out?
Cool one place without heating another.
